title: メジロという名の物語

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I see everyone is here. Bright, Ryan, Palmer, Dober…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait… Ramonu and Ardan appear to be missing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: They're not coming today. Ramonu's abroad and Ardan's still recovering.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …I see. Well then, let us begin. I trust you are all aware that the autumn Tenno Sho is approaching.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thus, it is time to begin another Mejiro family conference. Our topic for today is whether Bright can defeat Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The ensuing conference is so energized and heated, it would give the summer sun a run for its money…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I ran against her at the Takarazuka Kinen. If you're going to beat her, it's going to take something extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah. She runs so far ahead, calling her a front runner is a total understatement. Her speed is off the chain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hmm. So, we won't even have a chance unless we pull off something massive. Maybe we should bust out a new Mejiro style.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A new Mejiro style… Those words do have a lovely ring.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Let's discuss this further. What is the Mejiro style?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: How about we all share at once the quality we believe is quintessentially Mejiro?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All together now! Three, two, one!

text_block_list.name: All Five Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Long-distance! Explosive front running! ☆ Dash strength! Guts? Um…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone calls out their answers without reserve. It's hard to believe their images of the Mejiro family are all so different…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, are you all taking this seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Of course we are. It's just difficult to sum up us Mejiros in one word. We're all pretty different.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Still, we must have something in common, yes? What you mentioned before…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A Mejiro style! There must be one. A style that can outperform Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Meee?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bright is the one who's going to be racing, after all. She has to share her opinions if we want this conversation to go anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Um, in my opinion, what's most quintessentially Mejiro…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …Are us Mejiros. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Heh, Bright… You're not wrong, but is that really your answer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmm… The Mejiros are the Mejiros. In other words…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I understand, and I believe you may be onto something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like Mejiro Bright's answer struck an unexpected chord with Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What? McQueen, what do you mean she might be onto something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If you are born a Mejiro, then you are a Mejiro. But if you are not born a Mejiro, then you are not a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That is the only constraint there is. Consider it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We each have our own speed, stamina, and running style. If one has these talents, then you can improve them, yes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But only those born as Mejiros have our destiny, culture, and customs. In other words…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro story is ours and ours alone, and that story we continue to cherish…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Down Mount Yotei and through heavy snow, our founder trekked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus was the "mother mountain" awoken, and the earth was saturated with love, giving birth to the "giants."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At last, all her children opened their eyes for the first time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro Umamusume ran. Swift as the wind across grassy fields, valleys of flowers, deserts, and snowy plains. Until…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They ran in races, where they stirred the hearts of many with excitement and emotion, bringing smiles to their faces.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that is how all the Mejiro Umamusume became children of light, admired by all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I always loved that story as a kid…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: As did I. It's like an heirloom. Even just now, I felt entranced listening.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I used to lie awake at night thinking about Ramonu and how she was the first of us to win the Triple Tiara. She's a Mejiro heroine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I couldn't manage a single word when we first met, I was shaking too hard. Even now, when we stand on the turf together, I have to fight not to cry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I have a feeling that everyone here today will end up becoming just as dazzling as Ramonu someday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: There are Umamusume out there who admire McQueen the same way, and I'm sure you'll be just the same, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That's how our dream continues to live on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Precisely. The Mejiros are brought up surrounded by admiration, love, and pride.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That love specifically is related to the Mejiros' performance in races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But what does love have to do with running?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I get it… If that's the case, then this conference we're having right now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan makes a tight fist.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That means we're not just gathered here to help Bright win, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: We're here to ensure the new generation keeps the Mejiro legacy going, so it doesn't get washed away with the currents of time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. If we want the esteem surrounding our name to continue, we must cooperate and give every ounce we have to Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Every drop of our family's power will be given to her in the form of a single, piercing "resolution."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This power is unique to the Mejiros. The enduring bond we share cannot be found among friends or classmates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A story that has been passed down in an unbroken line for generations. I get it now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro story is what each of them build upon to produce its continued admiration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer. You said that the Mejiro style, Bright's style, can stay as it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Improve speed without sacrificing her stamina. Perfect the final stretch. Foster strength in all areas.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It may be the only choice we have. Yet, focusing together on this goal and honing Bright's skills with our individual techniques…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It will be a terrible burden to bear for her. Do you think she can handle it? Can she perfect a new Mejiro style?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I turn away from Mejiro McQueen's pointed stare and fix my gaze instead on Mejiro Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hmm… ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's a graceful smile on her face. Despite the calm in her expression, I can sense that she has made up her mind—she'll accept her destiny.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And if she feels that way…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My answer is confident. I know that we'll reach our goal in time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, I most certainly can. Everyone, I'll be in your debt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I will give my utmost, so please, do all you can to help me shine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright… Yeah! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, her special training begins with each of her five coaches training her in their own unique ways.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Urgh…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Bright, work more on your foundation!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You have to step harder. Harder! The weight of your step equates to the weight of your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Put your back into it, Bright! Run with all your muscles, not just the ones in your legs!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Move your entire body—push that power into the earth!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: U-understood!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wooo! I'll teach you my super front running strategy! Or, I would if I could, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Actually, maybe I'd be a good substitute for Suzuka. Let's partner run, Bright. See if you can catch me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Urk… Cough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Remember, Bright. You're not a burden to us. We're doing this for the Mejiro family we love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's keep on… no matter what it takes. As Mejiros in the same class, we celebrate together and we fall together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I understand, Dober…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They form a line and run along the beach. Ryan, McQueen, Palmer, Dober, then Bright taking up the rear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching them run is like looking at the history, and the future, of the Mejiro family.
